crime: In their cell, her partner draped woven sunlight over her shoulders and hummed their duet. Yet {WITCH_NAME} kept postponing rehearsals to alter the costume hems one more time. One morning, her partner announced that she would perform solo that night and returned the duet costume. {WITCH_NAME} smothered her to death with a pillow.

She hid the body beneath an ordinary blanket, tucking the sunlight fabric around it to keep it warm. That evening, the other prisoners saw her remain at a card game in the dining hall without leaving. When her partner missed the performance, a prisoner went to the cell and found her on the lower bunk. She had no pulse, but the nape of her neck was still warm. It looked as though she had been killed recently, while {WITCH_NAME} was in the dining hall.

Then the prisoner pulled back the blanket and uncovered the same sunlight fabric her partner had once draped around her. The prisoners saw the trick: its stored warmth had made a morning murder look recent, while the evening card game supplied her alibi.
fields.epitaph: She kept the warmth, but not the one who had shared it.
execution: A golden quilt drops over her, and the quilting frame on the execution stand locks her flat beneath it. The quilting needle drives through the quilt and her torso, over and over, stitching them together. The needle keeps sewing as one foot twitches beneath the frame. At last, even that small movement stops, and she lies still under the golden quilt.

magic.name: Woven Sunlight
magic.text: Weaves sunlight into soft fabric that holds its light and warmth.
